mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.name, d.is_default, d.is_private, d.created_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tickets t WHERE t.department_id = d.id) as ticket_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM staff s WHERE s.department_id = d.id) as staff_count FROM departments d WHERE d.id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM departments WHERE name = #{name}

SELECT d.id, d.name, d.is_default, d.is_private, d.created_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tickets t WHERE t.department_id = d.id) as ticket_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM staff s WHERE s.department_id = d.id) as staff_count FROM departments d ORDER BY d.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO departments (name, is_default, is_private, created_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{isDefault}, #{isPrivate}, datetime('now'))
mapper.update: UPDATE departments SET name = #{newName} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE staff SET department_id = #{targetDeptId} WHERE department_id = #{sourceDeptId}
UPDATE tickets SET department_id = #{targetDeptId}, assignee_id = NULL WHERE department_id = #{sourceDeptId}
UPDATE tickets SET assignee_id = NULL WHERE assignee_id IN (SELECT id FROM staff WHERE department_id = #{sourceDeptId})
UPDATE departments SET is_default = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
